result.summary: Several layout and clipping issues: restaurant cards and category chips are cut off, a promo restaurant card is missing its name/details, and the bottom navigation is cramped.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped on the right, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and ensure the last visible card peeks enough to indicate scrolling, or use a layout that keeps full cards on screen.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off on the right (Healthy chip and next item are truncated), so users cannot see the full set of filters.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and a clear peek of the next chip, or allow wrapping / a more complete scroll affordance.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' restaurant card shows an image and a -20% badge but has no restaurant name, delivery info, rating, or cuisine text below it.
issues.suggestion: Render the same metadata block as the card above (name, time, delivery fee, cuisine) so the listing is complete.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar icons sit very close to the screen edges and the home icon is tight against the left, making the nav look cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal padding and spacing between tab items so icons have more breathing room.

issues.description: The search field placeholder and icon are very light gray on a light background, reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder and icon color to improve contrast.
